segments.text:
V. 29.
And every one—In every Age and Country; not you my Apoſtles only: That hath forſaken houſes, or brethren, or wife, or children—Either by giving any o• them up, when they could not be retained with a clear Conſcience; or by willingly refraining from acquiring them: Shall receive an hundred fold—In Value, tho' not is Kind, even in the preſent World.
